items.title: Frontend fired API requests before backend was ready (ECONNREFUSED)
items.root_cause: Independent uncoordinated startup scripts without TCP/HTTP readiness waiting.
items.remediation: Updated start_local_stack.ps1 with bounded /health/ready polling; updated Header.tsx with bounded exponential backoff & single in-flight AbortController; added health gating in OceanVolumeViewport.tsx.

items.title: xarray Dataset.dims FutureWarning flood on readiness checks
items.root_cause: ds.dims.get('time', 0) in probe_essential_data() triggered xarray deprecation warning.
items.remediation: Replaced with ds.sizes.get('time', 0) and added 10-second thread-safe cached readiness probe.

items.title: NetCDF: Not a valid ID / fragile data access under load
items.root_cause: Shared lazy xarray Dataset handles across worker threads in analysis engine.
items.remediation: Implemented Strategy A: per-request open + eager NumPy materialisation + immediate close context. Validated across 100 multivariable sequential and concurrent requests.

items.title: TEOS-10 422/400 validation error on coordinate domain
items.root_cause: TEOS10Request schema was restricted to 80-88E, preventing queries in the 60-68E North Indian Ocean domain.
items.remediation: Expanded TEOS10Request latitude/longitude domain validation to [-3, 15]N and [60, 88]E; added pre-fetch client-side domain gating.

items.title: argopy/erddapy compatibility & network startup side-effects
items.root_cause: argopy 1.4.0 required erddapy 2.3.0 export and makes non-blocking ERDDAP index discovery.
items.remediation: Dependency pinned with erddapy 2.3.0 and pandas 2.3.3; verified offline core data independence.
